summary.text: Trevor Doiron is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 76 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a fourth-generation Jay resident and works as a consultant for the U.S. Small Business Administration.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Doiron as a graduate of Spruce Mountain High School and the University of Virginia (2022), with a profession of business consultant.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he graduated from Spruce Mountain High School in 2017, served as National Honor Society president, including a year as Maine state president, and later earned a graduate degree in public policy specializing in real estate and economic development.
He said he now works as a consultant for the U.S. Small Business Administration.
Doiron advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.

In the survey he said he is most passionate about economic development, lowering the cost of living and strengthening communities, including fixing the property tax system and improving access to health care and child care.
